company.name: Planet Memes Studio
company.shortDescription: Planet Memes Studio is building web3 gaming platform that merges the best of web2 and web3 gaming.
company.description: Planet Memes Studio is a Dubai-based Web3 gaming studio and blockchain gaming platform that combines meme culture, cryptocurrency, NFTs, and play-to-earn gaming experiences. Founded in 2022, the company develops blockchain-powered games where players can earn meme coins, NFTs, and in-game rewards while participating in a decentralised gaming ecosystem.
